category_fits.label: Consumer Behavior & Insights
category_fits.why_fit: The report is based on a global consumer survey and centers on changing attitudes and behaviors around fair value, spending, deals, AI-assisted shopping, trust, and human support.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report discusses implications for retail organizations, but business performance is not its main lens.

category_fits.label: Agentic Commerce & Shopping Automation
category_fits.why_fit: The AI chapter discusses virtual assistants automating reordering or meal planning and consumer expectations about when assistants act.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report does not make automated buying or checkout its central subject; AI-assisted shopping is one part of a broader study of consumer value, spending, and service.
rejected_topic_rules: Reject when the report is broadly about AI or automation without commerce execution at the center.

category_fits.label: AI & Automation
category_fits.why_fit: The report has a dedicated AI chapter covering virtual assistants, generative AI, personalization, and consumer concerns about AI use of information.
category_fits.why_not_fit: AI is one lens within a report whose broader subject is consumer behavior and value perception, rather than AI systems or automation as a general capability.
evidence_sections: Reliable tech builds loyalty – but with boundaries
rejected_topic_rules: Reject when AI is only one enabler inside a broader media, technology, or vertical-market report.

category_fits.label: Technology & Innovation
category_fits.why_fit: Technology-enabled shopping, personalization, and AI assistants appear in dedicated sections.
category_fits.why_not_fit: The report focuses on consumer expectations and behaviors, not technology platforms, infrastructure, or emerging technologies as the primary lens.
evidence_sections: Reliable tech builds loyalty – but with boundaries
rejected_topic_rules: Reject when technology is only a supporting capability inside a category-specific commerce, media, or healthcare report.

category_fits.label: Privacy, Identity & Data
category_fits.why_fit: The AI chapter reports concerns about how generative AI uses consumer information, and the technology chapter discusses privacy boundaries.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Privacy is addressed as a consumer concern within a broader report; identity resolution, compliance, and privacy-safe data management are not its central problem.
evidence_sections: Reliable tech builds loyalty – but with boundaries
rejected_topic_rules: Reject when privacy or data governance is just a constraint mentioned inside a broader AI, media, or measurement report.
